description: This file contains platform-specific functions and configuration settings for OpenWrt firmware upgrades, including image checks, upgrade procedures, and configuration copying for different hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image for specific board types and performs a legacy SD card check if matched.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the appropriate upgrade procedure based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data based on board type.
